parameters.content:
## WF3 — Tool Dispatcher

Called by WF2 on every VAPI `tool-calls` event.
Must respond within 5 seconds.

**10 Tools:**
1. lookupCaller → Sheets Clients lookup
2. checkAvailability → Calendar free/busy slots
3. bookAppointment → Calendar create + Appointment Log
4. rescheduleAppointment → Calendar update + Appointment Log
5. cancelAppointment → Calendar delete + Appointment Log
6. getBusinessInfo → Static info (hours, pricing, subsidies)
7. takeMessage → Messages tab append
8. scheduleCallback → Clients tab callback time
9. markDoNotContact → Clients tab DNC flag
10. createLead → Clients tab new row for unknown callers

**Credentials:** Google Sheets OAuth2 + Google Calendar OAuth2
**Sheet tabs:** Clients | Appointment Log | Messages

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.callerName + ' already has an upcoming appointment on ' + $json.Date + ' at ' + $json.Time + '. Would you like to reschedule that instead?' }}

additionalFields.description: ={{ 'Customer: ' + $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.callerName + ' | Phone: ' + $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.callerPhone + ' | Email: ' + $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.callerEmail + ' | Service: ' + $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.serviceType + ' | Address: ' + $('Parse Booking Request').first().json.address }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ $('Update Calendar Event').first().json.id ? 'Done. Your appointment has been moved to ' + $('Parse Reschedule Request').first().json.friendlyNew + '.' : "I wasn't able to update the appointment right now. Technical issue. Someone from our team will call you back to confirm." }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ ($('Update Cancellation in Sheets').first().json.error || $('Clear Upcoming Appointment').first().json.error) ? 'CALENDAR CLEARED BUT RECORDS NOT UPDATED. Tell the caller the cancellation is being processed and someone will confirm it shortly. Do NOT say it is fully cancelled.' : 'Your appointment has been cancelled. If you would like to rebook in the future, just give us a call.' }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ !($('Save Message to Sheets · Atomic Append').first().json.updates && $('Save Message to Sheets · Atomic Append').first().json.updates.updatedRows > 0) ? 'MESSAGE NOT SAVED. Tell the caller you could not log it, apologise, and ask them to call the office directly. Do NOT say it has been passed on.' : ($('Extract Tool Calls').first().json.args && $('Extract Tool Calls').first().json.args.urgency === 'urgent' ? 'I have flagged this as urgent. Someone will contact you as soon as possible, usually within a few hours.' : 'Got it. I have passed your message on and someone will call you back within one business day.') }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: I couldn't find an upcoming appointment for your number. It may have already been rescheduled or completed. Would you like to book a new appointment instead?

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: I couldn't find an upcoming appointment for your number. It may have already been cancelled.

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: I'm sorry, I didn't understand that request. Could you please try again?

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ 'Perfect, we will call you back at ' + $('Parse Callback Request').first().json.displayTime + '. Looking forward to speaking with you soon!' }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ $('Update DNC in Sheets').first().json.error ? 'OPT-OUT NOT SAVED. Tell the caller you could not complete it on the system, apologise, and say you are passing it to the team to action by hand. Do NOT tell them they have been removed.' : 'Of course. I have noted that. We will not call you again. Have a great day!' }}

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: I wasn't able to cancel the appointment right now. Please contact us directly and our team will get it sorted for you.
